objective: Complete the prespecified six-cutoff temporal schedule for the same three fixed Stage 1 text representation candidates; no new recipe or parameter search.
primary_metric: fixed-label [0,1] Macro F1 at fixed route threshold 0.50
primary_aggregate: Pooled Macro F1 over cycles 56-79 and equal-cycle mean of the 24 per-cycle Macro F1 values; also report all six four-cycle windows.

ranking_and_score_diagnostics.average_precision: Report for route candidate and C4 on identical validation rows as a ranking metric.
ranking_and_score_diagnostics.brier_score: Report as a descriptive probability score; DC_SVC expit(margin) is explicitly uncalibrated and Brier is not interpreted as calibration evidence.
ranking_and_score_diagnostics.class_metrics: Fixed-label [0,1] precision, recall, F1, support, and confusion matrix; include stream-present and stream-missing coverage.

missing_stream_policy: C1_B predictions reused from verified Round 1 caches; candidate replaces C2_B only for stream-present rows. No missing-branch refits.

complementarity.comparison_population: All stream-present primary validation rows from cycles 56-79, paired to C4_HGB predictions at the same rows.
complementarity.definitions: candidate_only_correct = C4 incorrect and candidate correct; C4_only_correct = candidate incorrect and C4 correct.
complementarity.fixed_blend_gate: Choose the highest full-six pooled Macro F1 candidate. Compute one fixed 0.50 candidate/C4 probability blend only if candidate_only_correct >= 25, C4_only_correct >= 25, and candidate_only_correct - C4_only_correct >= 0. Otherwise do not evaluate a blend.
complementarity.blend_rule: If gate passes, blend positive scores at weight 0.50, apply fixed threshold 0.50, and retain the unchanged C1_B route for missing-stream rows. No blend search or threshold tuning. This is adaptive development evidence.

stopping_rule: After all three full-six candidates, paired error diagnostics, and the single gated 0.50 blend (if eligible), stop the new classification recipe family if no candidate shows material, repeatable improvement; root decides any later research direction.
test_policy: Do not read/predict/score official Test. No Kaggle submission or leaderboard use.
adaptation_warning: All cycles 56-79 were used by earlier work; this full-six comparison is adaptive development evidence, not an independent holdout or untouched generalization estimate.
